plate_comment: Lowest-wins arbitration of the engine speed limit, the e2m high speed governor (HSG) reference speed (engine speed in 0.125 rpm counts; engine_speed_limit_default_cal = 30000 = 3750 rpm): each active source lowers lowest_source_speed_limit and records its number in limiting_source_number - 2 / 4 / 10 engine_speed_limit_source_2 / _4 / _10, 5 engine_speed_limit_fault_derate, 6 engine_speed_limit_reference, 7 fuel_pressure_fault_engine_speed_limit_working, 8 the TSC1 override mode select 1 request (DAT_0005c39a), 9 j1939_tsc1_override_state.etc1_torque_limit_value (governor mode 3), 11 governor_fuel_idle_limit, 13 engine_speed_limit_converter_slip, 14 engine_speed_limit_pedal_fault_mode, 15 engine_speed_limit_park_neutral_exit, 16 engine_speed_limit_source_16 (governor_active_flag_b648 set). Sources 16 and 8 return early with their own value as applied_speed_limit. Otherwise the result is held between engine_speed_limit_minimum (850 rpm) and engine_speed_limit_maximum (3500 rpm) and stored in engine_speed_limit_arbitrated; engine_speed_limit_ramped follows it (up by engine_speed_limit_ramp_up_step per pass, down at once). Sources 9 (with ETC1 active), 11 and, while engine_speed_limit_torque_converter_droop_enable is 0, 13 and 15 apply the ramped limit directly; every other pass applies the droop line unless the slope is 0: engine_speed_limit_droop_slope = (engine_speed_limit_droop_no_load_speed - engine_speed_limit_reference) x 4369 / (engine_speed_limit_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity - engine_speed_limit_droop_no_load_fuel_quantity) is recomputed unless engine_speed_limit_droop_slope_bypass_flag is set (source 10 zeroes the slope first, which sticks only while that flag is set), and applied_speed_limit = engine_speed_limit_ramped + slope x (engine_speed_limit_ramped_maximum_fuel_quantity - the clamped high_speed_governor_integral_term) / 4369, never below the ramped limit and capped at engine_speed_limit_droop_cap. cm848_calculateEffectiveFuelLimit and cm848_calculateEngineLoadPercentages read the same line as a fuel limit. (was cm848_selectTorqueLimit)

plate_comment: Name kept. Effective fuel limit with the engine speed limiter, in fuel quantity counts: the speed limit is engine_speed_limit_reference with engine_speed_limit_droop_slope while engine_speed_limit_droop_active_flag is 1 and the engine is still below lowest_source_speed_limit (or source 9 limits), otherwise lowest_source_speed_limit with the slope forced to 0. Below that speed the limit is injection_quantity_combustion_maximum_limit; above it it falls from engine_speed_limit_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity by the speed excess x 0x3ae1 / (slope x 8), floored at 0 and capped at protection_fuel_limit_cal_active (a zero slope cuts the fuel at once). The result is then lowered to the other fuel limits and, for the all-speed governor, to the droop fuel demand.

plate_comment: Computes the main injection timing (counts of 0.1171875 degree, larger = earlier) into main_injection_timing: the cold-start rpm x coolant map while cold_start_phase is CSP_ABOVE_RPM_TRIGGER / CSP_ABOVE_RPM_VIA_EVENTS / CSP_SETPOINT_UNDERRUN, otherwise the sum, highest or lowest (injection_timing_main_combination_mode 0 / 1 / other) of the coolant, intake temperature, barometric pressure and boost components (each an rpm x fuel_demand_computed angle map x a Q12 factor / 4096), injection_timing_main_base_command and a constant, then the floor, governor-limit minimum and working minimum; in delivery mode 3 it adds injection_timing_offset_cal and injection_timing_top_dead_center_offset (minus the top dead center position, 171 counts). The winning source goes to main_injection_timing_source_code, and the result is sent in PGN 65504 and is the angle of TPU-A channel 5 slot 8 (was cm848_calculateEngineTimingData).

plate_comment: Computes the third (auxiliary) injection start as a retard after the main injection, in counts of 0.1171875 degree: the highest (injection_timing_auxiliary_logic_select other than 2; 1 here) or lowest (2) of the map blend and the boost, ambient and coolant terms goes to auxiliary_injection_timing_retard and main_to_auxiliary_injection_timing_distance, and auxiliary_injection_timing = main_injection_timing - retard (or -(injection_timing_top_dead_center_offset (minus the top dead center position, 171 counts) + retard) when injection_timing_auxiliary_top_dead_center_referenced_flag is set). When injection_timing_auxiliary_override_switch is set it only copies injection_timing_auxiliary_override_value to main_to_auxiliary_injection_timing_distance, sets injection_timing_auxiliary_source_code to 7 and returns before auxiliary_injection_timing is written, so the override does not move the event (was cm848_auxiliary_boundary_condition_eval).
